meta.name: browser-automation-router
meta.description: Choose the narrowest reliable browser surface across Codex Browser, signed-in Chrome, Playwright CLI, and platform scripts. Use for browser automation, logged-in workflows, UI inspection, screenshots, form filling, publish previews, or frontend QA.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动选择最合适的浏览器自动化方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在多种浏览器环境中自动执行操作
copy.tagline_en: Automatically choose the best browser automation method
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automate browser tasks across different environments

howto.what: Claude 会自动选择最合适的浏览器工具（如内置浏览器、Chrome 扩展、Playwright 等）来执行自动化任务，例如截图、填写表单、检查页面等。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 进行浏览器自动化操作，如打开网页、截图、填写表单、检查 UI 或运行测试时触发。

say.text: 帮我打开百度首页并截图。
say.note: Claude 会使用内置浏览器打开百度并截图。

say.text: 用我的 Chrome 账号登录知乎并发布一条动态。
say.note: Claude 会通过 Chrome 扩展使用你的登录状态。

say.text: 运行 Playwright 测试脚本检查页面元素。
say.note: Claude 会使用 Playwright 执行自动化测试。

howto.what_en: Claude automatically selects the most suitable browser tool (e.g., built-in browser, Chrome extension, Playwright) to perform automation tasks like screenshots, form filling, and UI inspection.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to perform browser automation tasks such as opening web pages, taking screenshots, filling forms, inspecting UI, or running tests.

say_en.text: Open Baidu homepage and take a screenshot.
say_en.note: Claude uses the built-in browser to open Baidu and screenshot.

say_en.text: Log in to Zhihu with my Chrome account and post a status.
say_en.note: Claude uses the Chrome extension to leverage your login session.

say_en.text: Run a Playwright test script to check page elements.
say_en.note: Claude uses Playwright for automated testing.
